pages.text: [#](53341a)Place a normal **Cauldron** and use **Anointing Paste** upon it. The iron wakes into a Witch's Cauldron, fit for old craftings, composed brews, and cauldron rituals.[#]() [#](53341a)Fill it to the brim with a Water Bucket and heat it from below.[#]()
pages.title: The Cauldron

pages.text: [#](53341a)Fire, lava, a lit campfire, or a lit soul campfire will bring the water to working heat.[#]()
[#](53341a)Use the paste on a placed vanilla Cauldron; it is not a separate crafting-table block recipe.[#]()
[#](53341a)A bucket fills all three water levels. Rain and water bottles may also fill the vessel more slowly. A plain bucket removes full, unseasoned water and clears any unfinished brew.[#]()
pages.title: Ready for the Work
